outcome.summary: A corrected Codex CLI 0.146 matrix captured a real collaborationlist_agents PostToolUse event. Its tool_response is a JSON-encoded string; one uniquely named completed agent yielded exact UTF-8 bytes for a Unicode/newline fixture and for a predeclared 4,903-byte numbered fixture. Strict replay rejected unknown shape, wrong response type, ambiguous producer and syntactically truncated JSON. HTR-000 passes within the empirically verified 4,903-byte bound; HTR-001 still requires its normal refresh, selection and execution gates.

controlling_constraints: evidence-only prerequisite; no product runtime mutation
exact host-observed response is the only binding-output authority
no rollout scraping or agent-declared output-file substitution
HTR-001 remains unselected until normal downstream gates run

probe_configuration.hook_behavior: inert binary stdin capture plus process metadata

diagnostic_matrix.evidence: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop were captured by the disposable project hook.
The shell command executed and matching PreToolUse and PostToolUse events were captured.
PreToolUse and PostToolUse were captured; tool_response contained the running root agent.
All three direct function calls emitted matching Pre/Post events and the completed bytes matched the predeclared fixture.
The child generated only 259 characters and omitted the suffix; this cannot distinguish producer-generation failure from transport truncation and is not admission evidence.
The predeclared 130-line, 4,903-byte response matched exactly through PostToolUse.
The nested shell effect occurred and matching Pre/Post events were captured, disproving a general code-mode hook bypass.
The code-mode runtime returned TypeError because tools.collaboration was undefined; list_agents was not executed, so absence of its hook event is not a delivery failure.

agents.agent_status: running string or object containing completed

actual_event_contract.extraction_rule: UTF8(JSON.parse(event.tool_response).agents filtered to exactly one agent_name equal to the bound canonical task name [0].agent_status.completed)
actual_event_contract.correlation_rule: Require exactly one agent entry whose canonical agent_name equals the bound target and whose agent_status is exactly an object with one string completed field.
actual_event_contract.important_matcher_correction: The observed name is collaborationlist_agents with no dot or underscore. The current production matcher does not include list_agents and a future HTR-002 matcher must cover this exact spelling.

large_fixture.generator: BEGIN-LARGE-NUMBERED, then lines 0000 through 0127 formatted <index>|0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, then END-LARGE-NUMBERED

independent_replay.implementation: separate strict Python replay over captured raw stdin bytes

cases.case: completed text semantically shortened while schema remains valid
cases.reason: The payload exposes no independent truncation flag or expected digest; semantic shortening is not detectable from one event alone.

acceptance_matrix.evidence: Strict selector reproduced the predeclared 53-byte and 4,903-byte values and digests.
Both accepted fixtures contained exactly one canonical target name.
The short fixture matched exact UTF-8 bytes including Unicode and one blank line.
A 4,903-byte, 130-line predeclared fixture matched exactly; larger sizes are not claimed.

acceptance_matrix.check: unknown schema, ambiguity and syntactic truncation rejection
acceptance_matrix.evidence: Independent replay rejected each strict negative.
A valid shorter completed string has no truncation discriminator; downstream admission must remain within a bounded proven size and must not claim detection of silent semantic shortening.

downstream_constraints: HTR-001 may now be considered for selection, but this receipt does not select it or authorize runtime mutation.
Until additional evidence exists, an HTR-001 oversized-response policy must not claim completeness above 4,903 UTF-8 bytes.
HTR-002 must match the exact hook name collaborationlist_agents and parse tool_response as JSON text before applying the strict selector.
HTR-002 must fail closed on unknown response shape, wrong type, ambiguous name, non-completed status or invalid UTF-8/JSON.
A gpt-5.6-sol code-mode session did not expose tools.collaboration; a live rollout using that model requires a separately proven direct collaboration surface or a reopened capture-seam decision.
